Dear Viumo Family,

Version 1.1.6 is officially here! We’ve packed this release with expanded content, account safety tools, new settings customization, and a freshly redesigned player.

Here’s everything new in this update:

• Redesigned Player Experience: Enjoy a brand-new player UI built for better aesthetics, smoother controls, and enhanced functionality.
• Expanded Library Access: Stream and download even more content, including titles that were previously unavailable.
• Account & Recovery Controls: Complete ownership over your profile—you can now easily recover forgotten emails/passwords or permanently delete your account anytime.
• Profile & Settings Hidden Gems: Customize your experience! You can now adjust your simultaneous download limit (from 1 up to 5) and toggle auto-delete to clear completed movies automatically.
• Smarter Search & Stability: Faster, more accurate search results to help you find titles instantly, alongside major crash fixes for a seamless streaming experience.

Thank you for continuing to stream with Viumo and sharing your feedback to make the app better with every build.

Update now, explore the new player, and happy streaming!
